messages:
Alex: Hey all — thinking about a low-key "Retro Game Night" + late tacos next Saturday. Two options: A) Retro Night at 7pm -> tacos after B) Brunch at 11am -> arcade after. Also who needs a ride? I can coordinate carpools. :racing_car: :taco:
Nina: Retro night for me! Weeknights are rough, so evenings win. I can bring chips & salsa.
Jon: Brunch please 
(Soccer drop-off in the AM).
Riley: Night works. I can drive 2 folks from Mission. @Kai you good with evening?
Kai: Yep night is great. I can DJ a short playlist (20 songs) ":headphones:"
Bea: Brunch vote from me 
Also any GF/vegan options? I can bring a tofu scramble.
Alex: Cool. I'll spin up a quick poll and a tiny RSVP if people could add dietary notes.
EventBot: Poll created: "Retro Night at 7pm vs Brunch at 11am" day votes open (auto-close in 72h).
Nina: Add Nina to the RSVP.
Riley: Add Riley +1 (maybe name later).
Jon: Add Jon.
Kai: Add Kai. I'll bring a small speaker and aux cord.
Bea: Add Bea. Offering vegan dessert as well.
EventBot: Poll results: Retro Night 7 votes, Brunch 3 votes. Outcome: Retro Night confirmed. Venue: LevelUp Arcade (link: https://levelup.example). Time: 7:00pm. RSVP: https://forms.example/retro-night (please indicate carpool & dietary).
Alex: Booked 12 spots. I'll buy $10 game passes in bulk and take cash on arrival for reimbursements. DM me if you need a ride.
Kai: Playlist uploaded: https://open.example/playlist 
(90s/indie/lo-fi mix).
Bea: I'll bring vegan brownies and some napkins.
Riley: Carpool seats available: 2 from Mission, pickup at 6:15pm.
Jon: Bummer, actually can't make it now 
Have fun everyone!
Alex: No worries @Jon. Thanks for the heads-up.
Nina: Pumped! See y'all there.
EventBot: Reminder will post Friday 10:00am.
Alex: Closing thread 
Will post final carpool list on Friday. :sparkles:
